query:
insert into TestCaseOverrides (
                                latest_collection,
                                product_id,
                                test_run_name,
                                test_case_name,
                                review_name,
                                state,
                                rational_hash
                            )
                            values(
                                $1,
                                $2,
                                $3,
                                $4,
                                $5,
                                $6,
                                $7
                            )
                            on conflict (
                                product_id,
                                test_run_name,
                                test_case_name,
                                review_name
                            ) do update
                            set
                                latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                                state = excluded.state,
                                rational_hash = excluded.rational_hash
